pages.title: Power of Darkness
pages.text: A trophy left after defeating the Herald of Cold. It recalls a battle after which even the world around no longer seemed the same.$(br2)The heart embodies the $(l:beginning/paths)$(#7A3DB8)Path of Darkness$()$(/l).

pages.title: Heart of Cold
pages.text: Right-click the Echo of the Beyond with the heart in hand to lower the $(l:beyond/pursuit)Pursuit$(/l) meter by 100.
